patterns.note: Asymmetrical two-column layouts are frequently used, with a large heading on the left and supporting content or data on the right, creating a dynamic visual balance.

A single sans-serif typeface is used across the site, with a strong hierarchy established through varying weights (light for large headings, regular for body) and sizes, complemented by small, uppercase labels for metadata.

A stark, high-contrast dark theme dominates, featuring white text on a near-black background, with subtle light grey lines and borders providing visual structure without introducing strong accent colors.

The hero section features a subtle parallax effect on its background image as the user scrolls, while subsequent content sections reveal themselves with a gentle fade-up animation upon entering the viewport.
Accordion-style sections are used to present detailed information ('Investment areas', 'Our difference?') in a concise, expandable format, maintaining a clean layout.

technique_notes: The site employs a dark mode aesthetic with high contrast text and minimal use of color, relying on a clean sans-serif typeface for all content.

Scroll-triggered animations, likely powered by GSAP, are used to create a subtle parallax effect on the hero background image and to reveal subsequent content blocks with a smooth fade-up transition as they enter the viewport.
Information is structured using a flexible grid system that often pairs large, impactful headings with smaller, detailed content or data points in an asymmetrical two-column arrangement.

design_tokens.type_scale: large, thin headings (~4-5x body) with small, uppercase supporting labels, creating a sophisticated and airy feel
design_tokens.radius: sharp corners are consistently used throughout the design, contributing to a modern and precise aesthetic
design_tokens.spacing: very airy in the hero and between major sections, transitioning to a balanced density within content blocks and lists, maintaining readability and visual breathing room

standout: The site's distinctive use of a stark, high-contrast dark theme, combined with an abstract, painterly hero image and subtle scroll-triggered motion, elevates it beyond a typical corporate site. The design effectively communicates sophistication and depth through its minimal yet impactful visual language, making the presentation of complex financial information feel premium and authoritative.
